state: Price presses toward upper boundary resistance while immediate bullish momentum collides with heavy overhead selling pressure.
paragraphs: Price trades at 109.8, pushing above the latest confirmed high of 109.5 as buying pressure reasserts itself within an expanding volatility range. The upper Bollinger band sits right overhead at 109.97978, matching closely with the developing Deep Crab completion target at 109.975. Even though the confirmed swing structure exhibits lower highs and lower lows from a broader pullback perspective, the immediate sequence has turned bullish with high timing consistency and strong continuation scores. Buyers are pressing against the upper boundary with rising momentum, yet the heavy opposing wick pressure shows that sellers remain active just above current levels.

Broader history across the 104-brick window reveals a market accustomed to substantial advances, where bullish runs averaged 3.72 units against an average bearish run of just 2.06. Recent behavior shifts that dynamic by compressing the scale of those directional pushes. Over the last 12 runs, average bullish advances narrowed to 2.33 while bearish pullbacks held steady near 2.17. Even though buyers retain the upper hand through consistent timing and strong continuation scoring, the immediate advances are shorter than the historical baseline. Counter-moves are not expanding aggressively, yet the shrinking size of bullish extensions shows that upward momentum is facing a tighter ceiling as price approaches the overhead resistance zone.

Underneath the rising price action, internal measurements reveal a sharp increase in re-acceleration to 69.0 alongside a jump in transition pressure to 49.6, while chop remains subdued at 34.3. This combination shows that buying force is accelerating rapidly without falling into disorganized chop. Continuation scoring climbs to 73.4, backed by an orderly structural quality that confirms the advance is moving with high timing consistency instead of random noise. At the same time, compression has risen to 24.0, which indicates that the expanding volatility range is beginning to encounter friction. Buyers retain strong directional control in the immediate sequence, but the heavier internal transition scores show that control is being contested as price presses closer to overhead barriers.

Immediate support below rests in a stacked zone anchored by SAR at 109.19883 and the rising regression line at 109.12764, with confirmed low pivots at 109.05 and 108.9 sitting just underneath to reinforce the floor. The middle Bollinger band at 109.3275 also falls within this protective band. Overhead, the first resistance area is defined tightly by the upper Bollinger band at 109.97978 and the developing Deep Crab completion target at 109.975. The confirmed high pivot at 109.65 sits just inside this barrier path, marking the initial ceiling where buyers must contend with active selling pressure.

Continuation holds while buyers ride the upper Bollinger band at 109.97978, but fresh expansion is beginning to face friction. Compression has risen to 24.0 inside an expanding volatility envelope, showing that fresh volatility is no longer building behind the move even though price still has room to advance. A developing Deep Crab pattern at 109.975 rests directly overhead to provide active counter-pressure right as high opposing wick pressure confirms selling activity. This harmonic pattern is counter-pressure instead of a confirmed reversal, which means it introduces hesitation without dismantling the upward sequence by itself. The advance can extend further if buyers absorb that overhead supply, but failure to maintain pace above support will invite a deeper challenge to the trend.

Rapid switching, erratic timing, and frequent reversals keep the broader market unresolved. That disorder clears only when price settles into a persistent directional control or forms an orderly range. The bullish lean grows stronger if buyers maintain high continuation scores, keep counter-runs controlled, and push past the overhead resistance barrier without losing pace. Conversely, that upside case weakens if the opposing side expands counter-runs, accelerates downward pace, or reclaims the broken swing structure below current price. A stable range can replace the current choppy background without automatically reversing the existing directional bias, leaving the immediate outcome tied entirely to whether buyers can absorb the active selling pressure resting just overhead.
